banner_headline: Parliament Adjourned Again As MPs Refuse To Leave Poha Stall

hero_photo.scene: Hundreds of white-kurta MPs crowd a tiny poha-jalebi cart outside a grand domed Parliament building beside Upper Lake at sunrise.
hero_photo.caption: Quorum achieved at Raju Poha Bhandar, 8:40 am. Inside the House: eleven members and a pigeon.
hero_photo.secret: The pigeon has better attendance than 212 MPs this session.

stories.headline: Speaker Shifts Zero Hour To Poha Stall, Cites 'Ground Realities'
stories.text: After three adjournments, Speaker Om Tiwari moved Zero Hour to Raju Poha Bhandar itself. The Sev Subsidy Bill passed by voice vote, mostly muffled. Opposition staged a walkout but returned in four minutes for jalebi. Raju, 54, now holds more cabinet meetings than the Prime Minister and has demanded Z-category security for his kadhai.

photo.scene: A poha vendor in an apron bangs a ladle on a steel plate like a gavel as politicians raise hands.
photo.caption: Raju calls the House to order. Extra sev requires a two-thirds majority.
photo.secret: The ladle has since been classified as a parliamentary mace.

stories.headline: Delhi Applies For 'Heritage Town' Status, Asks To Be Remembered
stories.text: Former capital Delhi has quietly filed for Heritage Town status. At Connaught Place, retired peon Harish Lal, 71, still dusts an empty ministry office each morning. 'Someone may come back for a file,' he said. No one has since 1956. He keeps the kettle warm anyway, and waters the Secretary's money plant.

photo.scene: An elderly man in a faded uniform waters a money plant in a vast empty office with dusty files stacked high.
photo.caption: Harish Lal at his post. The plant is now nine feet tall.
photo.secret: Our photographer was the office's first visitor in 11 years; Harish made him sign the register twice.

stories.headline: Bakers' Strike Enters Day Six; Capital Faces Toast Crisis
stories.text: The New Market Bakers' Union strike continues over the government's plan to tax cream rolls as 'luxury pastry.' Embassies report rusk hoarding. The French ambassador was seen queueing at Raju Poha Bhandar and has since described poha as 'acceptable.' Talks resume Tuesday, venue undecided, though everyone knows where it will be.

photo.scene: Bakers in flour-dusted aprons sit cross-legged on a road holding placards shaped like cream rolls.
photo.caption: Union slogan: 'No Roll, No Vote.'
photo.secret: The placards were edible by day three and gone by day four.
